blocks.content: We'll use querySelector to select the game board.
Now, we want certain tasks to happen when a cell is clicked.
Instead of attaching an eventListener to each cell, let's attach it to the parent, gameBoard. When a cell is clicked, we'll get its data-index and write it into the cell using textContent.

When you click a cell, the event listener logs which cell was clicked by displaying its index (0 to 8) in the console:

items: event.target retrieves the specific cell that was clicked.
getAttribute('data-index') retrieves the index of that cell, and changes the textContent of the cell.
